verdict.rationale: Render's docs list a first-party "Rollbacks" topic, so the capability exists. The pack contains only that section title and no description of how rollback works. Missing for 10: evidence that rollback is a one-click action, evidence it can target any previous deploy rather than only recent ones, details of rollback behavior or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click
